disclaimers: Exploratory educational prototype. Nothing here certifies landing safety, power availability or communication availability.
Demo points A, B and C are demonstration coordinates chosen for this prototype. They are not NASA landing sites and are not approved, selected or recommended by NASA or anyone else.
Visibility refers to the direction of the body centre only. Sun-centre visible does not mean power is available; Earth-centre visible does not mean a radio link is available.
Gaps are reported within the selected analysis interval. A gap that touches the start or end of the interval may continue outside it.
Limits entered by the user are user-defined tolerances, not computed battery or link budgets.
Sun and Earth directions are JPL Horizons airless apparent topocentric azimuth/elevation of the body centre, sampled every 10 minutes and linearly interpolated between samples.
The geometric reference horizon ignores terrain. The terrain horizon is derived from LOLA elevation data at finite resolution and carries the stated uncertainty; results near the horizon are flagged.
Horizons UTC time tags after the last known leap second assume no further leap seconds.
